individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows pseudocoloured micrograph time-lapse images, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrograph images, not a plot, so error bars are not applicable.

individual-data-points.explanation: The main graphs plot the individual intensity measurements (scattered red and green points) over time rather than only a summary curve, so individual data points are displayed.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The insets show averaged early time-point responses with visible error bars on the data points, but the caption only describes what the insets represent (average euchromatin/heterochromatin responses) without stating what the error bars quantify (e.g., SD, SEM, n).
